name: forager
description: Forager: one OpenAI-compatible endpoint that routes across free LLM tiers on Cloudflare Workers

PROXY_API_KEY.description: Your router password: apps send it as a Bearer token, and you use it to sign in to /dashboard. Use a long random string (for example the output of openssl rand -hex 32) and save it in your password manager.

KEYSTORE_SECRET.description: Encrypts the provider API keys you add in the dashboard. Any random string of 16+ characters (for example openssl rand -hex 32). If you change it later, keys added in the dashboard must be added again.

AI_GATEWAY_ID.description: Optional. Name of a Cloudflare AI Gateway to log requests through. If it doesn't exist, Forager calls providers directly.

TRACKER.description: Durable Object that tracks free-quota usage per cycle and stores encrypted provider keys.

AI.description: Workers AI binding, used only to find your account ID for AI Gateway URLs.
